examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Financial Services band: four cards fill the grid beside the copy and its button. Edit the props in the Controls panel — add more than four items and the grid scrolls; a card with no title is skipped.

examples.name: Scrollable
examples.summary: Six cards: past four, the grid scrolls inside a fading scroll area, so the band keeps the height of its copy.
